publication.caveat: Submillisecond clusters and safety-callback overlaps are correlations, not DDS arrival/queue occupancy measurements or causal proof. Negative publish-end gaps are possible.

scope: Complete callback observations versus original unique timestamps. DDS receive time/sequence and reader queue drops are not observed; per-node missing values do not identify the internal loss mechanism. Header time gaps are not callback calculation times or real vehicle accuracy.
